import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    x = np.linspace(-10, 10, 400)
    y = 2 * x + 1

    ax.plot(x, y, color='red', label='y=2x+1')
    ax.plot(2, 5, marker='o', color='green', linestyle='None', label='solution at x=2')

    ax.set_title('Solution of the equation y=2x+1 at x=2')
    ax.set_xlabel('x')
    ax.set_ylabel('y')
    ax.set_xlim(-10, 10)
    ax.legend()

    return ax
